name: es_tax_id_validate
description: Validate Spanish tax identifiers: the DNI/NIF of a citizen, the NIE of a foreign national, the special K, L and M NIFs, and the NIF of a company or other legal entity (the former CIF) with its entity type and province code. A wrong check letter or digit comes back with the correct one.

id.description: Spaces, dots, dashes and an ES prefix are ignored

catalog.source: Real Decreto 1065/2007 (NIF) and Orden EHA/451/2008 (entity letters); check algorithms as in python-stdnum (github.com/arthurdejong/python-stdnum)
